reason: I don't know this app from anywhere -- no one in my building or my WhatsApp groups has used it, and you're asking me to put my card into something brand new just to save a bit on the freelancer's cut. Urban Company already takes care of the verification headache for me, so the 5% fee pitch doesn't move me when the thing I actually worry about is who's holding my payment details.
objection: Who is actually running hithozha, and what happens to my card/UPI details and my money if a booking goes wrong -- there's nothing here telling me it's safe, only that the freelancer is verified, not the app itself.
would_change_my_mind: If a few people I actually know -- in Tamil, not some English review on the website -- had used it and gotten their money back cleanly when something went wrong, and if I could pay via UPI on completion instead of upfront.
